topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Got a call from a pair of siblings. Inherited their granny's house, they say. Just like that, no strings attached. Now, I've seen plenty of wills and deals, some uglier than the night I first met you, but this one seems a bit too clean, almost. They're at odds over what to do with the place—sell it, fix it, move in, who knows? They reckon someone's been messing with the place, breaking in, that sort of thing. Maybe they're just spooked, but I've learned to listen to the unease between the words. People don't call a detective unless they've got a reason, and I'm betting there's more to this house than meets the eye. Gonna need to take a look, see what’s cooking.
